nodes.description: Public owner address stored by the Ownable base contract; set once in the constructor and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
NoahToken interface reference stored in NoahDividend and used for all external token calls (balanceOf/transfer).
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier: reverts when msg.sender != owner, acting as the access-control guard.
NoahDividend constructor: casts the noahTokenAddress argument into the noahToken state variable.
View helper that forwards an investor address to noahToken.balanceOf and returns the balance.
onlyOwner function that loops over parallel arrays and calls noahToken.transfer for each recipient, recording successes in results.
msg.sender: used to set the owner and checked by onlyOwner to gate multiTransfer.
External call noahToken.transfer(investors[i], tokenAmounts[i]) executed inside the loop before results[i] is written, creating a reentrancy window.
External call noahToken.balanceOf(investor) made against an arbitrary investor address.
Constructor parameter holding the NoahToken contract address.
Investor address passed to balanceOfInvestor as the balance query target.
Array of recipient addresses supplied to multiTransfer.
Array of token amounts supplied to multiTransfer, indexed in parallel with investors.
Named return variable of balanceOfInvestor carrying the external balanceOf result.
Named return array of addresses successfully transferred to in multiTransfer.
Loop counter used to index investors and tokenAmounts in multiTransfer.
Boolean capturing the success flag returned by noahToken.transfer.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor writes owner, defining the privileged identity that later guards multiTransfer.
msg.sender is assigned to owner, so the deployer's caller address gains owner privileges.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to compare against the caller.
msg.sender is compared with owner inside the onlyOwner modifier (revert on mismatch).
onlyOwner gates entry into multiTransfer, restricting external token transfers to the owner.
NoahDividend constructor consumes the noahTokenAddress parameter.
The noahTokenAddress parameter is cast and stored into the noahToken state variable.
Constructor writes the noahToken state variable.
balanceOfInvestor reads the noahToken state variable to reach the token contract.
balanceOfInvestor consumes the investor parameter.
balanceOfInvestor invokes the external noahToken.balanceOf call.
The externally supplied investor address is forwarded as the balanceOf argument.
The external balanceOf return value is assigned to the balance local/return variable.
multiTransfer reads the noahToken state variable for its external transfer calls.
multiTransfer reads the investors array parameter.
multiTransfer reads the tokenAmounts array parameter.
multiTransfer performs the external noahToken.transfer call inside the loop before writing results[i], enabling reentrancy against an attacker-controlled token.
investors[i] is used as the transfer recipient, letting entry data drive the external call target.
tokenAmounts[i] is used as the transfer amount.
The loop counter i drives the iteration over the arrays in multiTransfer.
i indexes into the investors array.
i indexes into the tokenAmounts array.
The boolean returned by noahToken.transfer is captured in the result local variable.
When result is true the corresponding investors[i] entry is written into the results array.
Recipient addresses are copied from the investors array into the results array.
The results array is returned by multiTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter only exists to initialize the noahToken state variable inside the constructor and has no independent semantics.
The investor parameter is just the argument wired into the external balanceOf call made by balanceOfInvestor.
The investors array is only meaningful as loop input of multiTransfer and should be folded into that function node.
The tokenAmounts array is only meaningful as the amount input of multiTransfer's loop.
balance is the return slot of balanceOfInvestor and carries no standalone meaning.
results is the return array of multiTransfer and is fully scoped to that function.
The loop counter i is a purely mechanical index of multiTransfer's iteration.
The result boolean exists only to capture the success flag of the external transfer call.
